title: Glowing robot vacuum
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8ff3ff' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8ff3ff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- soft glow pool under the vacuum -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='44' ry='14' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- floor shadow ring -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='34' ry='9' fill='#2a5a7a' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- main body: rounded disc -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='36' ry='20' fill='#3ec9e8'/>
  <!-- top disc (darker shade of its own colour for an edge) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='36' ry='18' fill='#5fe0f7'/>
  <!-- inner ring detail -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='24' ry='12' fill='#7ff0ff'/>
  <!-- bumper arc at the front -->
  <path d='M16 60 A36 20 0 0 0 84 60' fill='none' stroke='#2a9fbf' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sensor eye / glowing status light -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='7' fill='#1a6d8a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='4.5' fill='#b6fbff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- side lights -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='56' r='3' fill='#b6fbff'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='56' r='3' fill='#b6fbff'/>
  <!-- little wheels peeking out -->
  <rect x='30' y='72' width='10' height='6' rx='3' fill='#1f7a95'/>
  <rect x='60' y='72' width='10' height='6' rx='3' fill='#1f7a95'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#d8fdff'>
    <path d='M22 34 l2 4 l4 2 l-4 2 l-2 4 l-2 -4 l-4 -2 l4 -2 z'/>
    <path d='M78 30 l1.5 3 l3 1.5 l-3 1.5 l-1.5 3 l-1.5 -3 l-3 -1.5 l3 -1.5 z'/>
    <path d='M50 22 l1.5 3 l3 1.5 l-3 1.5 l-1.5 3 l-1.5 -3 l-3 -1.5 l3 -1.5 z'/>
  </g>
</svg>
